title: Refill Adherence Score
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pharmacy:refill
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(adherence_score) as avg_adherence_score min(adherence_score) as min_adherence_score by _time household_member
| sort - _time
value: A simple adherence score gives you a weekly snapshot of whether the refill system is supporting the routine or undermining it.
implementation: Send pharmacy refill adherence score events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of pharmacy refill adherence score, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It builds what is happening with pharmacy refill adherence score, so odd changes stand out quickly.
